tools.name: browser_exec
tools.description: Execute Python in the browser-harness session. Helpers like new_tab(url), goto_url(url), page_info(), click_at_xy(x, y), type_text(text), js(code), cdp(method, ...), wait_for_load(), list_tabs() are pre-imported. The namespace persists across calls. Returns whatever the code prints. First navigation should be new_tab(url).

tools.name: browser_screenshot
tools.description: Capture the current page and return it as an image. Prefer this over capture_screenshot() in browser_exec.

max_dim.description: Downscale so no side exceeds this many pixels (e.g. 1800 for 2x displays)
